notes: Triage run. Closed 105 stories with reasons via fuse.mjs done (in 5 batches). Reasons: about 70 niche or vendor-patched CVEs with no sign of exploitation (WordPress plugins, MCP tools, small libraries, FFmpeg, Free5GC, Dell and CVE-only stories with titles visible); 12 not-cyber, marketing or opinion; 6 leak-site claims or small-private-company claims; 5 non-event policy or conference items; 2 individual crime cases. Not closed: about 90 CVE-only stories with no visible title (e.g. CVE-2026-80473, CVE-2026-119072, CVE-2026-126740) because I could not identify the software, which the rules say to leave open; government-source stories (RBI, CERT-SE, SI-CERT, GovCERT.HK, NKI Hungary, INCIBE, CIRA); Sploitus PoC items; and the strong stories listed in open_leads. No pages were opened and no searches were run; all decisions came from titles and source lists from fuse.mjs list and show. About 1,521 open stories remain. Oldest open strong story: not determined (the list output gives no first-seen times); the UK, Air Force and Slovenia stories were already in the queue at the start of the run. For data/status.json (not written by me, per worker rules): last_triage_at 2026-11-27T21:16:30Z; triage_note: closed 105 (about 70 niche CVEs, 12 not-cyber or marketing, 6 claims, 5 policy or conference, 2 individual cases, 10 other); left open about 1,521 incl. 4 priority-1 story clusters; oldest open strong story: not determined.
